Hey Centralcontroll,

Taking this off twiter because the answer is longer than 140
characters...

The browser interface uses gwt, so you'll need to compile before
uploading. If you make a copy of the whole sample, and just update the
appengine-web.xml to your own appid, then you can deploy the whole
thing with

mvn gae:deploy

Which will take care of building the gwt interface.

If you're more interested in a restful api, take a look at
LotREPLsApiImpl. You can use this servlet as a starting point for a
servlet that handles restful requests instead of GWT RPC-- it should
be much simpler because if it's really restful you don't need to
preserve state between requests!

I will try to add a sample for restful gae app when i'm back from Chad
after the 23rd.

Best,

Alex
